lines.en: Eight legs move at once; I walk sideways.
My shell is heavy; I cannot hurry.
Sand and gravel crunch under my feet.

lines.zh: 我从蘑菇丛后面绕过去。
lines.en: I go around behind the mushroom cluster.
I keep my claws up so they stop knocking.

lines.zh: 一寸一寸挪，我有的是时间。
lines.en: Inch by inch, I have all the time.
Moss scrapes off along my shell.
I step sideways to clear the path.
The red mushroom tilted; I set it straight.
Each step makes my warts jiggle.
The island is small; I patrol it slowly.

lines.zh: 壳太重，影子拖在我身后。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; my shadow drags behind.
My legs bend, and my shell sways.
I walk this circuit once each day.

lines.zh: 我踩到沙里的贝壳，换条腿。
lines.en: A shell in the sand; I switch legs.

lines.zh: 我在礁石边横着挪开半步。
lines.en: I sidestep half a pace at the reef's edge.
I squat under a mushroom cap, listening.
My claws tap against each other twice.
No one comes, so I sun my shell.
A little spore dust settled on my warts.

lines.zh: 我伏着不动，像长满苔的石头。
lines.en: I lie still, like a mossy stone.
I blink; my lashes keep the sand out.
A mooshroom is lowing somewhere far off.
There is dampness inside my shell.
The island is quiet enough to make me sleepy.
I grind the moss off my claws.
When my breathing slows, my shell stops creaking.
I am counting this year's mushroom rings.
The wind blows spores onto my back.
Nobody came; that is fine.
The damp makes my shell heavier.
A grain of sand is stuck in a joint.
You are standing beside my mushroom.
I look up at you and lower my claws.

lines.zh: 你踩的是哞菇的旧脚印。
lines.en: You are standing in an old mooshroom print.
Your boots are covered in spores.
I am not afraid; my shell is thick.
Something in your hand keeps swinging.
Do not shine that torch at my warts.
I know people; you do not come often.
You take one step, then I raise my claw.

lines.zh: 我从蘑菇伞下看了你很久。
lines.en: I have watched you long from under the cap.
You are casting your shadow on my shell.
What are you laughing at? My shell is fine.

lines.zh: 壳上添了一条细细的白痕。
lines.en: A pale line has opened across my shell.
One claw hangs; I cannot lift it.
Not the face; my lashes will break.

lines.zh: 这点疼，还动摇不了我的壳。
lines.en: This pain will not shake my shell.
A patch of moss was knocked off.
I back away behind the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 四十滴血，也经不起这样。
lines.en: Forty health does not last through this.
My warts feel hot.
You broke a layer off my shell.
I grunt, like grinding stone.
Do not touch that red mushroom.

lines.zh: 是蘑菇的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: That is mushroom smell; I caught it.
Let me see the one in your hand.
Poison does not scare me; you taking it does.

lines.zh: 孢子落在你肩上，我看见了。
lines.en: Spores landed on your shoulder; I saw them.
Put it closer; my claw can reach.

lines.zh: 这岛上的蘑菇我都认得。
lines.en: I know every mushroom on this island.
You crushed one; that pains me.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是想守着它。
lines.en: I will not eat it; I only want to guard it.
That red spot wobbles in your hand.
You think a mushroom will make me leave?

lines.zh: 我壳上的苔也在等孢子。
lines.en: The moss on my shell is waiting for spores too.

lines.zh: 把蘑菇凑近些，我闻一闻。
lines.en: Bring the mushroom closer; let me sniff it.

lines.zh: 别急着收走，我还没看够。
lines.en: Do not put it away yet; I am not done looking.

lines.zh: 你手里那朵是红的还是白的。
lines.en: Is that one in your hand red or white?

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，只是想看得清。
lines.en: I raise a claw only to see it better.
What just knocked against my shell?
I sidestep back two paces.
Your leg knocked against my claw.
Thick shell, heavy body; I will not budge.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的疣撞歪了。
lines.en: That knocked one of my warts crooked.
No shoving from behind, please.
Shell against shell makes a muffled knock.
I got squeezed into the mushrooms.
I am steady; I have eight legs.

lines.zh: 往边上让让，我横着过去。
lines.en: Step aside; I am coming through sideways.
I tap my shell three times with a claw.
It answered once, very softly.
Two crabs walk sideways side by side.
It has more warts than I do.
We guard the same patch of mushrooms.
It rests its claw on my shell.

lines.zh: 不急，这岛够我们慢慢走。
lines.en: No rush; this island has time for us.
Its eyes shine brighter than mine do.
We patrol this circuit together.
With it here, the island is not empty.
I pinch a small mushroom.
I keep this broken shell piece.
I lift it with both claws.
It fell by my feet; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它按进壳上的裂缝。
lines.en: I press it into a crack on my shell.
Not for eating, but worth keeping.
I carried it a long way.

lines.zh: 这朵是谁掉的？我替它拿着。
lines.en: Whose did this fall? I will hold it.
My claws are clumsy and keep slipping.

lines.zh: 我放它下来，又夹回钳里。
lines.en: I set it down, then pinch it back up.
Something over there does not belong here.

lines.zh: 骨头走路的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear the sound of walking bones.
The green one; I do not touch it.
That one explodes; I go around.

lines.zh: 有只僵尸从水里上来了。
lines.en: A zombie just climbed out of the water.
It crushed a mushroom ring.

lines.zh: 我的钳子自己抬起来了。
lines.en: My claws have risen on their own.
That thing is sniffing my shell.
That smell does not belong on this island.
I turn my whole shell around.
I close in sideways, making no sound.
It retreats; I keep pace.
I block its path with my claws.
Under the moss, I hide my body.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就近一步。
lines.en: Every time it moves, I step closer.
Do not hide behind the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的脚踝，等它落地。
lines.en: I watch its ankles, waiting for a landing.
I make this circle very slowly.
It fears me; I am not rushed.
When it comes close, I raise my claw.
Both claws snap shut with a click.
This one will make it remember me.
I smash into its knee.
My heavy shell hurts even when I ram.
One claw flipped it over.

lines.zh: 它跑不远，我等着它倒下。
lines.en: It will not get far; I wait for it to drop.
I strike once and step back half.
My claw is harder than it looks.
It cried out; I did not let go.
Eight points of damage; I count it clearly.

lines.zh: 我在蘑菇岛的石头上醒来。
lines.en: I wake on a stone of the mushroom island.
My shell is still soft; it needs sun.
The one beside me woke a step earlier.
This mushroom patch marks my border.
I crawled out of a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 孢子落在我刚硬的壳上。
lines.en: Spores settled on my newly hardened shell.
The island is small; it fits us two.
First thing: walk one patrol round.
I walk sideways across my spawn point.
The wind carries mooshroom smell.
Fire scorches my shell; the moss burns.

lines.zh: 我从石头上翻下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall off the rock and land shell-first.

lines.zh: 水漫过壳顶，我钳子乱抓。
lines.en: Water covers my shell; my claws grasp at nothing.

lines.zh: 我被炸得翻了身，腿朝天。
lines.en: The blast flipped me, legs to the sky.

lines.zh: 箭钉进壳缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my shell crack.
That light wraps me; my shell goes cold.

lines.zh: 蘑菇吃完了，我壳都轻了。
lines.en: The mushrooms are gone; my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷打在我壳上，八条腿全麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit my shell; all eight legs numb.
I fall into blackness with no bottom.
